drawCount.title: Draw
drawCount.help: How many cards are turned over from the stock at a time. With three, only the top one can be played.

passes.title: Passes Through the Deck
passes.help: How many times you may go through the stock. Once a pass ends, the waste is turned back over into a new stock, until the passes run out.

undo.title: Undo
undo.help: Whether a move can be taken back. Taking a move back also takes back the points it scored.

description.UNLIMITED: Take back as many moves as you like.
description.LIMITED: Each tableau gets a fixed number of undos per deal.

undoLimit.title: Undos per Deal
undoLimit.help: How many moves each tableau may take back in one deal when undo is limited. A shared tableau shares them.

hint.title: Hints
hint.help: Whether you can ask for a hint. A hint flashes a move worth making: a card and where it goes, or the stock.

description.UNLIMITED: Ask for as many hints as you like.
description.LIMITED: Each tableau gets a fixed number of hints per deal.

hintLimit.title: Hints per Deal
hintLimit.help: How many hints each tableau may ask for in one deal when hints are limited. A shared tableau shares them.

scoring.title: Scoring Style
scoring.help: How a tableau is scored. The player or team with the most points across every deal wins.

description.STANDARD: Points for every move that makes progress, and a bonus for clearing that grows the faster you were.
description.VEGAS: Each deal costs 52, and every card on a foundation pays 5 back.

timeLimit.title: Time per Deal
timeLimit.help: How long every deal may run. When the time is up, the deal ends for everyone.

rounds.title: Deals
rounds.help: How many deals the match plays. Points carry over from one deal to the next.

firstFinish.title: First Clear Ends the Deal
firstFinish.help: When on, the deal ends for everybody the moment one side clears its tableau. When off, everyone plays on until they clear, give up or run out of time.

foundationTakeBack.title: Take Back from Foundations
foundationTakeBack.help: Whether a card on a foundation may be moved back down onto the tableau.

autoComplete.title: Auto-Complete
autoComplete.help: Once every card is face up and the stock and waste are empty, the tableau finishes itself.

howToPlay.title: The Rules
description: Build every suit up from the ace to the king on the four foundations. On the tableau, build columns down in alternating colors, and move a run of cards together by moving the card it starts with.
Only a king can go into an empty column. Click the stock to turn cards over when you run out of moves. Click a card and then where it should go, drag it there, or double-click it to send it home.

modes.title: Playing Together
description: Every tableau in a deal is dealt the same cards. In Versus everyone plays their own, and the race is to clear it first. In Teams each team shares one.
In Co-op the whole table plays a single tableau together. Clear every deal before the time runs out to win.

undoAndGiveUp.title: Undo and Giving Up
description: Depending on the settings, you can take moves back as often as you like, a set number of times per deal, or not at all.
Stuck? Give up and the deal stops waiting for you. Move again and you are back in.

info.undoLeft: Undo ({count} left) | Undo ({count} left) | Undo ({count} left)
info.hintLeft: Hint ({count} left) | Hint ({count} left) | Hint ({count} left)
info.noMoves: No moves left. Give up to end your deal.
info.noMovesUndo: No moves left. Undo to try another way, or give up.
info.cardsHome: No cards home | {count} card home | {count} cards home
